stops.note: an imitative name for the parrot, of uncertain deeper origin
the bird's name and reputation for gaudy plumage spread into Iberia
carried further north through medieval trade and literature
the ending was reshaped to resemble "jay"; later applied figuratively to vain, showy people
stops.meaning: parrot, later a vain talkative person

current_meaning: a vain or conceited person who dresses or talks in a flashy, showy way
